newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK ALPHA CREDIT TO CUT PRIME RATE 75BPS FEB 17.
newsitem.headline: GREEK ALPHA CREDIT TO CUT PRIME RATE 75BPS FEB 17.

text.p: Greece's Alpha Credit Bank will slash its prime rate by 75 basis points to 14.75 percent and its deposit rates by 50 to 75 basis points effective February 17, it said in a statement.

The bank cited the central bank's decision to cut its intervention overnight bid by 50 basis points today and its Lombard and discount rates by 100 basis points from February 17 in justifying its decision to cut its deposit and lending rates.
The bank kept its maximum add-on margin on the prime rate unchanged at 3.50 percent.
Alpha Credit Bank also reduced its Alpha 500 lending rate by 75 basis points to 14.75 percent plus the maximum add-on, it said.
It cut its adjustable-rate mortgages by 0.75 percent to 15 percent from 15.75 percent and its Alpha 100 lending rate to 18.25 percent. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
